title: ChemInform Abstract: Synthesis and Thermoelectric Properties of the Novel A‐Site Deficient Zn<sub>0.5</sub>Rh<sub>2</sub>O<sub>4</sub> Compound.
abstract: AbstractThe new thermoelectric title material is obtained from Li0.5Zn0.5Rh2O4 (obtained by solid state reaction of Li2CO3, Rh2O3, and ZnO in air at 1000 °C for 24 h) by immersion into an aqueous solution of K2S2O8 (1 and 10 d).
